# Frozen declarative v0.1 outputs

These six JSON files are expected outputs of the synthetic CG-12 external
architecture/coverage scenario. The CG-12 test compares all values and array
order exactly, ignoring JSON object key order. They protect Situation, Delta,
Plan, capability bindings, process/policy explanation and minimal per-step
CG-02 projections across revisions. They contain no real project data.

Updates require contract review; no test automatically rewrites expectations.
See [quality gates and evidence](../../../docs/declarative-quality-gates.md).
